'''Uvena Prime''', or '''Uvena I''', was the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanens]] in the [[Uvena system]]. The species, capable of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-level technology, emigrated to other uninhabited worlds of the system, including [[Uvena III]], to prevent strangers from outlying systems from arriving and settling them. As of at least the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet was led by a monarchy, which made use of the royal [[Shistavanen Star Cruiser]] known as the [[Malachite Scent]].
